subject: English
question_text: Change the narrative style of the following text.
stimulus: Once a student said to his teacher, "How can I make a good result in the examination, sir?" "You must read attentively from today," replied the teacher. "Your advice is very excellent! Thank you, sir," said the student. "May you obtain A+ in the SSC exam.
guide_solution: Once a student respectfully asked his teacher how he (S) could make a good result in the examination. The teacher replied that he (S) had to read attentively from that day. The student exclaimed that his (T) advice was very excellent and respectfully thanked him (T). The teacher prayed that the student might obtain A+ in the SSC exam.
